objective: Fail closed before reflection-probe or formal benchmark rendering if any protected subtle physical-data texture has drifted from its domain import-precision contract.

renderBoundaryPolicy.reason: Reflection cubemaps and final camera evidence must sample the same already-prepared physical-data texture state. Import repair after cubemap capture would invalidate material/reflection coherence.

failureInjection: Regress one protected domain texture to block compression and require reflection-camera pre-cull failure.
Enable a Standalone platform override on one protected texture and require reflection-camera pre-cull failure.
Disable mipmaps or reduce anisotropy on one protected texture and require formal camera pre-cull failure.
Change one protected normal away from NormalMap and require failure before reflection or formal evidence rendering.
Remove smoothness input alpha from one protected mask and require failure before reflection or formal evidence rendering.
Regress one park-furniture physical-data map to compression and require the same reflection/formal fail-closed behavior as the other protected domains.
Regress one generic PBR physical-data map to compression and require reflection/formal pre-cull failure for concrete, paving, soil, vegetation or bark evidence.
Capture reflection probes in a clean state, mutate protected importer state, then require final formal pre-cull failure rather than accepting stale cubemap/material coherence.
